narrative.headline: The Falcons are the team on the rise
narrative.blurb: 14 games in week 6. The Vikings are No. 1 at 5-0 with a +45 point differential. The AFC's last playoff spot is the Raiders at 3-2. The NFC's last spot is the Bears at 3-2. The Falcons lead the heat check at 2-1 and +35 points over the last three games.

rankingsBlurb: Point differential shrunk toward a league-average team, plus the margin over the last three games. Movement is since this week's order was frozen.
trendingBlurb: Point differential over the last three games. Heating up is the best stretch. Cooling off is the worst.
afcBlurb: Seven AFC clubs play on. The line under the seventh seed is the cut line.
nfcBlurb: Seven NFC clubs play on. The line under the seventh seed is the cut line.
weekBlurb: Week 6 kickoffs, with the score once a game is live or final.
